notes: Shared defaults. provider: jev (TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter, needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment, never stored here) | laya (local laya-serve) | kev (local Kev server, TypeSafe-compatible). --provider wins over env DECISION_PROVIDER, which wins over this file. Thresholds are the cookbook's starting values, not calibrated on BMad data: re-pick them with `suggest.mjs --eval`. Per-machine overrides go to jev.local.json (gitignored).
